snippet.title: The Organized Capy God - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
✨ Play the demo & wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585550/The_Organized_Capy_God/

Game is coming out August 1st, 2025!

Help Capy God reunite with his family! Sort, organize and group items in this relaxing and chill game!
